friendly_name: Release-protection posture for the service-v* line
purpose_context: The service-release environment guards only the publish job. Issue #221 names the remaining paths: a branch workflow with contents: write can create an unreviewed release, the canary mints an org-wide App token, the main ruleset needs no approval and has an always-bypass actor, and nothing checks the live settings for drift. Before the first non-rc service-v* tag, M4 (#239) adds a scheduled read-only audit, an expected-settings file, tests, and a release guide section that records each control or accepted risk.
purpose_tldr: Close the release paths around the protected publish job: a daily read-only audit of live settings and service releases, a narrower canary token, and a guide that maps every vector to a control or a signed-off accepted risk.
